svg.title: Graph of a positive-definite quadratic form
svg.desc: The surface z equals 13 x squared minus 6 x y plus 5 y squared is an elliptical bowl with minimum at the origin. It rises in every direction and has a horizontal elliptical rim at z equals 36.
